listings.name: Newcastle Medical Hub
listings.description: Newcastle Medical Hub in Mayfield offers comprehensive general practice services including antenatal care, chronic disease management, skin cancer checks, and women's and men's health. On-site allied health services include physiotherapy, podiatry, and dietetics.

listings.name: Broadmeadow Medical Centre
listings.billing: Mixed billing — bulk bill at doctor's discretion for concession holders and children
listings.description: One of Newcastle's largest non-corporate medical centres. Broadmeadow Medical Centre has on-site pharmacy, physiotherapy, pathology, and a dedicated skin cancer clinic. Mixed billing with bulk billing available at the doctor's discretion for concession card holders and children.

listings.name: Zion Medical Centre
listings.description: Established in 2013, Zion Medical Centre on Hunter Street is a highly-rated practice with 500+ five-star Google reviews. Led by Dr Sarathy, the practice offers comprehensive primary care with a focus on patient-centred, relationship-based medicine.

listings.name: Mayfield Medical Connection
listings.description: Established in 1938, Mayfield Medical Connection is one of the area's most enduring practices. Currently accepting new patients, with a multidisciplinary team including Drs Rahman, Hanks, and Boyd. On-site psychology, nutrition, physiotherapy, and pathology services.

listings.name: Mayfield Medical Centre
listings.description: A trusted family practice on Maitland Road, Mayfield Medical Centre provides general GP services, chronic disease management, and women's, men's, and children's health. Convenient location with experienced GPs.

listings.name: Newcastle After Hours Medical Service
listings.description: Newcastle's oldest medical deputising service. NAHMS provides after-hours GP consultations at Broadmeadow and a mobile home doctor service across the Newcastle region. Fully bulk billed — no out-of-pocket cost for Medicare cardholders.
listings.google_search: Newcastle After Hours Medical Service NAHMS

listings.name: Hamilton Medical Centre
listings.address: Level 1, 400 Glebe Road, Hamilton South NSW 2303
listings.description: Hamilton Medical Centre is a well-established family GP practice in Hamilton South. The experienced team provides comprehensive primary care across all age groups, with a focus on continuity of care and preventive health.
listings.google_search: Hamilton Medical Centre Hamilton South Newcastle

listings.name: HealthSure Medical Centre Jesmond
listings.address: Level 1, Shop G01-G07, Stockland Mall, 28 Blue Gum Road, Jesmond NSW 2299
listings.billing: Mixed billing — bulk bill for children under 16 and Centrelink concession holders 60+
listings.description: Located in Stockland Mall Jesmond, HealthSure Medical Centre is a mixed billing practice covering all aspects of primary care. Bulk billing available for children under 16 and Centrelink concession holders aged 60+. Now offers ear microsuction (microsuction) on-site.

listings.name: Charlestown Medical & Dental Centre
listings.billing: Mixed billing — bulk bill for concession cardholders and children under 16
listings.description: Charlestown Medical & Dental Centre combines GP and dental services under one roof. Extended hours including Sundays make it a convenient option for working families. Bulk billing available for concession card holders and children under 16.

listings.name: Wallsend Medical Practice
listings.description: Wallsend Medical Practice offers fully bulk billed GP services in Wallsend. Part of the Healthcare Evolutions network, the practice provides comprehensive primary care including chronic disease management, mental health support, and preventive care.
